F: Upward pull of the surface on the column, 2πrγ cos θ
gamma: Surface tension: the pull of the surface on each meter of edge
h: Height of the liquid in the tube above the level outside; negative when it is pushed down
s: Slope of the straight line fit: of h against 1/r, 2γ cos θ/(ρg); of h against cos θ in Analysis 3, 2γ/(ρgr)
in mm² (mm in Analysis 3) from the graph
theta: Contact angle where the liquid surface meets the tube wall, measured inside the liquid
